evidence.reason: The code mutates `counts[category]`, `targets`, and possibly `exclusions` before validating every path row. A null/non-record path throws inside the loop, and the catch only increments `counts.unverified`, leaving the earlier aggregate updates in place and double-counting the receipt. This is a routine implementation bug in the existing status-summary behavior; validating into locals before committing aggregate updates is the smallest compatible fix.
